language.description: Language code of the track to write: one of the subtitle languages of Studio.

source.description: True when writing the source (transcript) track

dubbing.description: True when writing a dubbing track

bgVolume.description: Dubbing background-audio volume, 0 (mute) to 2 (double); only honored for dubbing tracks

speakerVolumes.description: Per-speaker volume overrides (dubbing only), at most 200 speakers. Each value is from 0 to 2; a value outside the range is refused with `400`.

speakerVoiceSettings.description: Per-speaker TTS voice settings (dubbing only), at most 200 speakers.

segmentsToRedub.description: Segment ids that should be re-synthesized after this update. Re-dubbing makes new speech, so it is refused with `403` when your organization has used up its credits; saving the text without `segmentsToRedub` is not.

enqueueTtsUpdate.description: When true (default), the dubbing segments listed in `segmentsToRedub` are queued for TTS regeneration from their `words`. Set to false to save edits without re-synthesis (for example, text-only fixes) — you must still send the full `words` array for every segment.

subtitles.description: Full segment list for the target language track. The endpoint performs a bulk replace, so the array must contain every segment in the final state, not just the edited ones. Every segment must include a non-empty `words` array; omitting a segment deletes it, and an empty `words` array drops the segment on the next read. At most 20,000 segments.

editedBy.description: Accepted and ignored: a save through the API is always attributed to the API in the version history.
